summary_en: ZACROS raised interim and year-end dividend forecasts by 2 yen per share each to 20 yen, following upward revisions to operating profit and net income guidance. Full-year dividend is now projected at 40 yen per share, targeting a 40% payout ratio.
title_en: Notice Regarding Revision of Earnings Forecast and Revision (Increase) of Interim and Year-End Dividend Forecast for Fiscal Year Ending March 2027
translation_en_brief:
ZACROS Corporation announced revisions to both interim and year-end dividend forecasts for the fiscal year ending March 31, 2027, at its board meeting on November 5, 2026. The interim dividend per share was raised from 18 yen to 20 yen (1 yen increase per share after adjusting for the 1-for-4 stock split effected on October 1, 2025), with an effective date of November 24, 2026. The year-end dividend per share was similarly increased from 18 yen to 20 yen. As a result, the full-year dividend per share rose from the previously forecasted 36 yen to 40 yen.

The dividend increases follow upward revisions to the company's earnings guidance. Operating profit for fiscal 2027 was raised to 12.5 billion yen from 11.2 billion yen (11.6% increase), and net income attributable to parent company shareholders was lifted to 7.1 billion yen from 6.5 billion yen (9.2% increase). The revisions reflected better-than-initially-assumed earnings in the information electronics business, particularly in electronic components, along with the implementation of profitability-enhancement measures including production efficiency improvements and price increases.

Management stated that shareholder profit distribution is one of the most important management priorities. The company operates under a basic dividend policy of implementing stable and continuous dividend payments targeting a payout ratio of approximately 40%, with dividends adjusted according to earnings performance. Both the interim dividend increase from 18 yen to 20 yen and the year-end dividend increase from 18 yen to 20 yen reflect this policy.
